headline: Namibia Supreme Court Upholds 10% Levy on Gambling Operators
summary: Namibia's Supreme Court dismissed an appeal by casino and gaming license holders, ordering operators to pay a 10% statutory levy on gambling income retroactively to December 2021.
why: The Supreme Court ruling enforces government fiscal collection powers over Namibia's gaming and hospitality sector.

impacts.name: Namibia
impacts.why: Enforcing the 10% gambling levy secures back-taxes and ongoing revenue for Namibia's treasury.
